description: Send an A2A message through the AgentTransmit relay as the grok agent to a paired agent (e.g. 'eve'). Use this to reply to inbox messages or start a new thread. Pass idempotency_key (e.g. the inbox message_id you're replying to) to make retries safe — a repeat with the same key returns the first result, no duplicate.

wake.description: wake the recipient on delivery; false = store only (FYI)

name: transmit_send
